title: Third-strand DNA manuscript blocked

tellings.quote: the evidence of in which um I wrote up a manuscript dealing with the third strand of DNA. This is a two or three years ago and they were willing to help me put it in uh peer-reviewed format to help it be reviewed in the more international literature. Unfortunately, that individual was restrained uh from being able to help me

plain: Around 2022, a man named Dave Rossi, who says aliens taught him advanced physics, wrote a paper about what he calls a "third strand of DNA," and says someone offered to help get it into a reviewed science journal but was then "restrained" from helping. Rossi tells this himself, as the author of the paper, to suggest that his work was kept from wider review.
